sentences.text:
1  THIS LAND ACQUISITION APPEAL HAVING COME UP FOR HEARING ON 12.03.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 LAA No.45 of 2020 2 2025:KER:21142  JUDGMENT Easwaran S., J.

The State has preferred this appeal aggrieved by the judgment and decree dated 10.4.2019 in L.A.R.
No.94 of 2013 on the files of the Principal Sub Court, Kollam.

2. The brief facts necessary for disposal of the appeal are as follows:
An extent of 0.55 Ares of land comprised in Survey No.78/1 Kollam West Village in Kollam Taluk was acquired for widening of the Kollam Taluk Office-Civil station road.
Section 4(1) notification was issued on 23.11.1998.
The Land Acquisition Officer fixed the land value at Rs.1,60,556/- per Are.
Dissatisfied with the fixation of land value, the claimant sought reference under Section 18 of the erstwhile Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

The reference court, on appreciation of the evidence, found that the claimant was entitled for enhancement of the land value and thus enhanced the same by Rs.2,96,804/- per Are totalling to Rs.4,57,360/- per Are.
In the application for reference under Section 18, the claimant had also sought severance compensation for 0.35 Ares of land.

On the basis of the evidence adduced by the parties before it, the reference court concluded that the claimant is entitled for severance LAA No.45 of 2020 3 2025:KER:21142 compensation and awarded a total compensation of Rs.2,16,270/- [(Rs.4,57,360+Rs.1,60,556)x0.35 Ares].
It is against the grant of severance compensation that the State has preferred this appeal.

3. Heard Sri. T.K. Shajahan, the learned counsel appearing for the appellant/State and Sri.Prasanth S.R., the learned counsel appearing for the respondent/claimant.
4.

On consideration of the rival submission raised across the Bar, we find that the calculation made by the reference court while awarding severance compensation for an extent of 0.35 Ares of land is incorrect, and the same requires modification.

5. Even if we are to assume that because of the peculiar nature of the property and its position, the claimant is entitled to 100% enhancement, the reference court could not have granted an amount of Rs.2,16,270/- especially since the enhancement granted by the reference court is only Rs.2,96,804/-
per Are totalling to Rs.4,57,360/-, which represents the land value.
Therefore, the correct value to be fixed towards severance compensation is Rs.1,60,076/- [Rs.4,57,360x0.35 Ares].

sentences.text: In view of the above, we are of the view that the judgment and decree of the reference court requires modification.
Hence, the appeal is allowed.

The judgment and decree of the Principal LAA No.45 of 2020 4 2025:KER:21142 Sub Court, Kollam in L.A.R. No.94 of 2013 is modified by re-fixing the amount towards severance compensation at Rs.1,60,076/- i.e., Rs.4,57,360x0.35 Ares.
